title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
description: A comprehensive ERP suite integrating manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and human resources for a large corporation.

modules.name: Supply Chain Management
modules.description: Tracking raw materials from suppliers to factory floors.

modules.name: Manufacturing Execution
modules.description: Managing production orders, machine schedules, and QA checkpoints.

modules.name: Financial Accounting
modules.description: General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, and automated tax reporting.

modules.name: HR & Payroll
modules.description: Employee lifecycles, benefits administration, and complex payroll runs.

project_objectives: Unify 4 disparate legacy systems into one platform

title: Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
description: A highly customizable CRM platform for sales teams to track leads, manage pipelines, and forecast revenue.

modules.name: Lead & Pipeline Management
modules.description: Customizable Kanban boards for tracking sales opportunities.

modules.name: Email Integration
modules.description: Syncing with Gmail/Outlook to track email correspondence with clients.

modules.name: Custom Fields & Workflows
modules.description: Allowing admins to define custom data models and automation rules.

modules.name: Reporting Dashboard
modules.description: Drag-and-drop report builder using Elasticsearch for fast querying.

project_objectives: Support millions of customer records with fast search
Allow non-technical users to build custom workflows

title: IT Service Management (ITSM) Helpdesk
description: An internal ticketing system for IT departments to handle employee issues, asset management, and change requests.

modules.name: Ticketing System
modules.description: Creating, assigning, and tracking support tickets with SLA timers.

modules.name: Asset Management (CMDB)
modules.description: Database of all company laptops, servers, and software licenses.

modules.name: Knowledge Base
modules.description: Searchable wiki for employees to find self-help articles.

modules.name: Change Management
modules.description: Approval workflows for major infrastructure changes.

project_objectives: Reduce average ticket resolution time by 30%
Ensure 100% compliance with change approval processes

title: Document Management System (DMS)
description: A secure system for storing, versioning, and collaborating on corporate documents with strict access controls and audit trails.

modules.name: Version Control
modules.description: Tracking document history and allowing rollbacks to previous versions.

modules.name: Granular Permissions
modules.description: Defining access down to the individual document and user level.

modules.name: Full-text Search
modules.description: Indexing document contents for rapid retrieval.

modules.name: Audit Logging
modules.description: Immutable log of who viewed, edited, or downloaded every file.

project_objectives: Ensure compliance with legal data retention policies
Provide instant search across millions of documents

title: Employee Intranet & Collaboration Portal
description: A central hub for company news, employee directories, internal social networking, and resource sharing.

modules.name: News Feed
modules.description: Algorithmic feed of company announcements and departmental updates.

modules.name: Employee Directory
modules.description: Searchable org chart with rich employee profiles.

modules.name: Workspaces
modules.description: Project-specific groups for team communication and file sharing.

modules.name: Internal Events
modules.description: Calendar and RSVP system for corporate events and webinars.

learning_outcomes: Handling rich text and media content
project_objectives: Provide a unified platform replacing 3 legacy tools
